label: Nonnecessary versus contingent root
resolution: The fork's second horn, STMT-NECESSARY-OR-NONNECESSARY-ROOT, uses nonnecessary (¬ NecessaryAt), a negated universal. Contingent (ContingentAt) adds a witnessed accessible world lacking x. A contingent root is nonnecessary without excluded middle; the converse is proved only with STMT-EXCLUDED-MIDDLE as a hypothesis (contingentRootOfNonnecessary). Because that hypothesis is explicit in every theorem that crosses over, no step silently swaps the quantifiers. Neither sense is a counterpart notion: both are de re over rigid candidates (CounterpartControl), and both are relative to the frame's accessibility (AccessibilityControl).
